title: Integrations module: signed webhooks, delivery worker, outbox API, and API reference docs
acceptance: Subscription CRUD routes and service fns match openapi and WebhookSubscription.schema.json; create returns secret once; secret stored encrypted (secret_enc) and never returned or logged afterwards

Delivery worker subscribes to '*', filters by event_types and active, POSTs JSON envelope with X-FNOL-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 hex of raw body using the subscription secret), plus X-FNOL-Event-Id; test verifies signature

Failed deliveries (non-2xx or network error) retry with exponential backoff up to a max attempt count, recorded in webhook_deliveries; idempotent per (subscription, event id); injectable clock/fetch in tests
listDeliveries is paginated by cursor; GET /integrations/outbox lists via ctx.bus.outbox with type/subject/afterSequence/limit
index.mjs service(ctx) composes webhooks plus the adapters service from ./adapters/index.mjs (S1-INT-03) via guarded dynamic import so it loads when that file is absent

architecture/contracts/tools/gen-api-reference.mjs generates docs/api-reference.md from openapi.yaml (zero dependencies) and preserves hand-written sections: authentication, tenancy, errors, events and webhooks (with a Node signature verification example), pagination
Tests pass: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/integrations/webhooks/ tests/unit/integrations/docs/ tests/integration/integrations/webhooks/
brief: Part A, webhooks: src/modules/integrations/webhooks/{service,worker,signing,routes}.mjs. Use ctx.db for tables webhook_subscriptions, webhook_deliveries (see modules.md), ctx.crypto.encryptPii/decryptPii for the secret, ctx.bus.on('*', handler) with consumed_events idempotency, ctx.clock for backoff (e.g. 30s, 2m, 10m, 1h, 6h; 5 attempts then status 'failed'). Deliver through an injectable fetch (default global fetch) with timeout; validate target URLs (https only except localhost in dev/test; block private ranges in prod config) to avoid SSRF. Retry scheduling: persist next_attempt_at and provide worker.tick() driven by a ctx timer/interval; tests call tick() with a fake clock. Payload is the event envelope (no PII). Include a test receiver using node:http in tests/integration. Part B, wiring: index.mjs exports service(ctx); the adapters service (owned by S1-INT-03) exposes createAdapterService(ctx) from ./adapters/index.mjs returning { listAdapters, previewMapping, pushClaim, routes }; import it with try/catch dynamic import and use a local stub in your unit tests. routes.mjs registers all integrations routes including those the adapter service returns. Part C, docs: gen-api-reference.mjs parses openapi.yaml; since zero-dependency, write a minimal YAML reader sufficient for this file or load via flow-style/JSON-compatible subset - check the file first; if a parser is impractical, post a contract-change asking for an openapi.json mirror rather than adding dependencies. Generated section markers (<!-- BEGIN GENERATED --> ... END) let hand-written sections persist; add an --check flag. Do not edit package.json. Only synthetic data. Do not commit.
valueDrivers: Faster integrator onboarding via API reference

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 48 tests pass (run per file), docs check up to date, secret encrypted, guarded adapter import, in-scope paths only
